title: AI-guided mining identifies and engineers an alkaline xylanase
summary: A fine-tuned sequence model and generative workflow guided identification of xylanase 8E20 and mutant 8E20-178. The primary abstract reports an optimum-pH shift from 8 to 10 and a 1.9-fold improvement, but calls the metric catalytic activity while indexed conclusion text calls it catalytic efficiency; this draft preserves the ambiguity. It does not infer unreported assay conditions or industrial-scale performance.
ai_technology: AAEPre sequence model; xynODM generative model
organization: Institute of Animal Science, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences

evidence.tested: Primary abstract reports 8E20-178, pH optimum shift and 1.9-fold improvement.
evidence.unknown: Publisher full text inaccessible; exact improvement metric and assay conditions unresolved. Prior sequence characterization and independent replication not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Sequence models and composite selection index prioritized candidate enzyme; generative model guided variant engineering.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
